name: Greene County, MO
findings: Greene County has 1,140 nonprofit organizations. 466 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 370 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Greene County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few community organizations list membership
observations.text: 7 community organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 17 would.
